title: Granite Ridge Season Pass Financing Schedule: Instalment Terms by Tier
content:
## Financing terms published for the Season Pass Programme

Whether a Granite Ridge season pass may be financed over scheduled instalments, and on what terms, is set per tier. Five figures are published: whether the tier may be financed at all, the number of scheduled instalment charges the financed balance is divided into, the day of the month on which each scheduled instalment falls, the one-off service fee added to the pass account when a plan is opened, and whether a stored payment method must be on file for the tier to be financed.

| Tier | Financing offered | Scheduled instalments | Charge day of the month | Plan service fee (USD) | Stored payment method required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | no | 1 | 15 | 0.00 | no |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | yes | 4 | 15 | 19.00 | yes |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | yes | 5 | 15 | 19.00 | yes |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | yes | 6 | 15 | 24.00 | yes |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | yes | 6 | 15 | 24.00 | yes |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | yes | 8 | 10 | 29.00 | yes |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | yes | 10 | 10 | 0.00 | yes |

### Reading the schedule

The two tiers that carry no service fee do so for different reasons: the Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass is not financed at all, while the Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass is financed over the longest schedule in the programme, 10 instalments, at no service fee.

The charge day is a day of the month, not an interval: on every tier up to the Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass it is the 15th, and on the Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass and the Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass it is the 10th.

The service fee is a single amount in USD added to the pass account when the plan is opened, not a charge repeated at each instalment.
